verdict.rationale: HumanLayer documents creating tasks from GitHub, Linear and Jira issues and syncing issue status. Nothing in the evidence shows it automatically triaging incoming issues, suggesting severity, or routing them to an owner. Ingesting issues as tasks is an adjacent feature, not the triage-and-routing capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have incoming issues automatically triaged with severity suggested and routed to the right owner

citations.quote: Connect Linear so HumanLayer can create tasks from Linear issues, sync issue status, and link HumanLayer artifacts back to the source issue.
Connect GitHub to create HumanLayer tasks from issues and link task artifacts back to the source issue.
